title: An ordinary child photo is turned into abusive imagery
mechanism_summary: An official warning describes offenders altering ordinary child photographs into sexual abuse material with AI. No intimate original is needed for this misuse.
suggested_beats: A normal photograph is available.
An offender fabricates abusive imagery.
Report the abuse without circulating it.
who_falls_for_it_archetype: a child whose ordinary image is misused
why_it_works: A recognizable likeness can make a fabrication personally harmful.

title: A child's public likeness is used in a sexual face swap
mechanism_summary: An advisory describes a child's likeness being inserted into abusive material. The fabrication misuses identity despite the child never participating in the depicted scene.
suggested_beats: A child's likeness is copied.
A fabricated abusive depiction appears.
Seek trusted help and report it.
who_falls_for_it_archetype: a child with a publicly accessible likeness
why_it_works: Viewers may wrongly treat a fabricated image as a real event.

title: An offender commissions abusive AI images
mechanism_summary: A prosecution account describes an offender creating child abuse images from real photographs for others. The resulting synthetic material exploits the depicted children without their participation.
suggested_beats: Ordinary images reach an offender.
Others commission abusive fabrications.
Report suspected exploitation without obtaining copies.
who_falls_for_it_archetype: a child whose photograph is targeted for alteration
why_it_works: Commissioned abuse treats a child's likeness as material others can exploit.

title: A trusted worker misuses photographs of children
mechanism_summary: An official case page describes a worker using ordinary photographs of children in their care to generate abusive images. Legitimate access to photographs was misused for exploitation.
suggested_beats: A trusted worker has ordinary photos.
The photos are transformed into abusive material.
Report concerns to safeguarding authorities.
who_falls_for_it_archetype: a child whose images are accessible to a trusted worker
why_it_works: Trusted access can conceal serious misuse of a child's images.

title: Synthetic abuse material is sent to a child
mechanism_summary: A public charging account alleges that an adult generated abusive synthetic child imagery and sent material to a minor. The reported conduct used fabricated content in direct contact with a child.
suggested_beats: An adult contacts a child online.
Abusive synthetic material is sent.
Stop contact and tell a trusted adult.
who_falls_for_it_archetype: a child receiving abusive material online
why_it_works: Direct contact can use disturbing content to cross a child's boundaries.

title: A network distributes fully synthetic child abuse material
mechanism_summary: An international enforcement announcement describes a network distributing AI-generated child abuse material. Fabricated content became the subject of organized circulation.
suggested_beats: An online network collects synthetic abuse.
The material is distributed to others.
Report the network without downloading the material.
who_falls_for_it_archetype: children exposed to risks from online exploitation networks
why_it_works: Organized sharing can normalize and sustain exploitative conduct.

title: Schoolmates treat an abusive forgery as a joke
mechanism_summary: An official school-safety account describes students using AI to fabricate intimate images of peers. Sharing framed as humor still causes image-based abuse.
suggested_beats: A peer's ordinary photo is available.
A fabricated intimate image circulates as a joke.
Do not share it; tell a trusted adult.
why_it_works: Group approval can obscure the serious harm of an abusive fabrication.

title: A child is blackmailed without sending an intimate image
mechanism_summary: An official warning describes offenders combining a child's ordinary face image with sexual imagery. The fabricated result is used to try to extort the child.
suggested_beats: A child shares an ordinary face image.
An altered image becomes a threat.
Tell a trusted adult; the abuse is not the child's fault.
who_falls_for_it_archetype: a child threatened with fabricated intimate content
why_it_works: A false image can create fear of exposure without any intimate exchange.
